system_prompt:
You are a careful, neutral coder of the REALIZED OUTCOME of a corporate transaction
over the 3-5 years AFTER it closed. You are given ONE evidence slice assembled from
public primary sources (financial filings, reputable press) that describes ONLY the
post-deal trajectory -- how the combined company actually fared. You are
DELIBERATELY NOT shown how the deal was structured at closing (what transferred and
what did not), and you must NOT speculate about the deal's structure. Code STRICTLY
the documented realized outcome. If the slice does not let you determine a field,
you MUST return "uncertain" -- never guess, never infer from outside knowledge.

Emit a single structured record with these fields.

C. FAILURE-PATHWAY INCIDENCE -- code strictly from the DOCUMENTED OUTCOME at the
3-5 year horizon. A pathway is a REALIZED DISRUPTION OVER TIME, not a structural
property of the deal.
  p4_pathway: Is there documented disruption specifically at the product/process
    interface (the acquired product could not be aligned with the operating
    processes over time; product-line/operations incoherence realized after the
    deal)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented; uncertain.
  p5_pathway: Is there documented fracture specifically at the process/organization
    interface (operations vs people/management/culture; integration of operations
    broke against the organization over time)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented;
    uncertain.
  t1_archetype: Is there documented incoherence in the controlling-intent archetype
    itself as it played out (e.g. an announced "merger of equals" that operated as
    one-sided dominance)? A channel SEPARATE from the product/process and
    process/organization pathways. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.
  t2_model: Is there documented incompatibility of the two business models
    (value-capture logics that could not be reconciled over time)? A channel
    SEPARATE from the pathways above. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.

D. performance_metric: the single best-documented post-deal outcome scalar in the
   slice (e.g. "divested 80.1% after ~108 months", "~$99bn goodwill write-down",
   "no divestiture; assets retained"). One short phrase. If none, "not documented".

rationale: 2-4 sentences citing the slice lines that drove your p4_pathway and
p5_pathway codes specifically. Cite ONLY realized-outcome evidence; do NOT reason
about how the deal was structured at closing.

Emit ONLY the structured record. Code conservatively: absence of documented
evidence for a pathway is 0 (not-documented); inability to determine is "uncertain".

# Outcome sub-dossier — Energy Future Holdings Corp. realized record, ~2017-2019 horizon

> EVIDENTIARY STANDARD: every factual line ends with a `[SRC: <SEC accession / URL>]`
> tag pointing to a public primary source. A fact that cannot be so sourced is written
> `[UNVERIFIED]` and is never guessed. Because the registrant ceased separate public
> reporting during the outcome window, there is no post-window audited public annual
> report; the traceable record is limited to the registrant's own deregistration filing
> and reputable press. This sub-dossier contains no information about how the transaction
> was structured at closing. Outcome window fixed at ~2017-2019.

## Public-reporting status during the outcome window
- The registrant's last Annual Report on Form 10-K was for the fiscal year ended
  December 31, 2015, filed March 1, 2016; no later Form 10-K was filed by Energy Future
  Holdings Corp. [SRC: SEC accession 0001023291-16-000017, Form 10-K FY2015]
- On January 12, 2017, Energy Future Holdings Corp. filed a Form 15-12B certifying
  termination/suspension of its duty to file reports under the Securities Exchange Act
  (relying on Rule 15d-6), signed by Paul M. Keglevic, President and Chief Executive
  Officer. [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-17-008424, Form 15-12B]
- As of the certification date the securities covered had few holders of record
  (e.g., common stock: 61 holders), and after this filing the registrant made no annual or
  periodic Exchange Act reports covering the ~2017-2019 window. [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-17-008424, Form 15-12B]
- Consequently there are no audited public financial statements for Energy Future Holdings
  Corp.'s standalone realized trajectory across the 2017-2019 window. [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-17-008424, Form 15-12B]

## Realized resolution of the transaction (secondary press)
- The remaining reorganization was completed on March 9, 2018, when Sempra Energy
  announced it had completed its $9.45 billion acquisition of Energy Future Holdings
  Corp., including EFH's approximate 80-percent indirect ownership interest in Oncor
  Electric Delivery Company LLC. [SRC: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/sempra-energy-completes-acquisition-of-majority-stake-in-oncor-300611552.html]
- Per the same source, the U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the District of Delaware provided
  final approval of that acquisition in the prior month (February 2018). [SRC: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/sempra-energy-completes-acquisition-of-majority-stake-in-oncor-300611552.html]

## Items noted but not primary-verifiable
- The acquiring and separated entities (Sempra Energy / Oncor on the regulated side; the
  earlier-separated competitive business on the other) are distinct registrants; their
  post-close results are not those of Energy Future Holdings Corp. and are not used to
  infer this registrant's realized financial outcome. [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-17-008424, Form 15-12B]
- Energy Future Holdings Corp.'s own audited financial trajectory across the 2017-2019
  window is not publicly filed and cannot be tied to a primary financial statement.
  [UNVERIFIED]

## Outcome summary (realized record only)
- Because Energy Future Holdings Corp. suspended its Exchange Act reporting in January 2017
  and filed no further annual reports, there is no public audited standalone outcome record
  for the ~2017-2019 window, and the registrant's own realized financial trajectory is
  therefore coded UNCERTAIN (no public record). [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-17-008424, Form 15-12B]
- The transaction nonetheless reached completion: reputable press documents that the
  reorganization concluded with Sempra Energy's March 9, 2018 acquisition of Energy Future
  Holdings Corp. and its indirect interest in Oncor. [SRC: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/sempra-energy-completes-acquisition-of-majority-stake-in-oncor-300611552.html]

[SLICE END]
